commands.author: brokemac79

target.title: fix(review): keep maturity labels out of issue lease revisions
target.body:
## Summary

- keep ClawSweeper-managed `maturity:stable` out of both issue source-revision implementations
- preserve revision changes for ordinary, protected, and `proof: override` labels
- cover the review/apply digest and the repair/router digest with matching focused tests

This prevents an exact issue review from invalidating its own apply-time mutation check after synchronizing the managed maturity label. It does not weaken exact-revision lease ownership, pull-request head-SHA coordination, human/protected-label drift detection, close safety, or security-label scanning.

## Problem and confirmed mechanism

The first exact review of an issue can validate its source revision, add ClawSweeper-owned labels, and then validate the revision again. Priority and impact labels were already revision-neutral, but `maturity:stable` was not. Adding it changed `itemSourceRevisionSha256`, so the same worker failed with:

```text
issue source revision changed while holding the apply mutation lease
```

Failure reconciliation then returned the original `issues/opened` queue item to pending. A later run legitimately acquired a new lease and posted another review-start placeholder. The two workers did not overlap.

For openclaw/openclaw#104977:

- [run 29180589969](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29180589969) checked out `a7edd3f`, posted the first start marker at 2026-07-12 05:04:20 UTC, added `maturity:stable` at 05:12:08, and rejected its own revision at 05:12:10
- the run failed and completed at 05:12:17
- retry [run 29180841398](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29180841398) was created at 05:12:54, posted a new start marker at 05:14:04, and succeeded

Independent end-to-end examples show the same `maturity:stable` → two-to-three-second CAS rejection → successful retry sequence on openclaw/openclaw#104972, #104979, and #104984. The behavior also predates the July 12 cache/concurrency merges; [run 29085983494](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29085983494) reproduced it on July 10.

## Implementation

- `src/clawsweeper.ts`: use the authoritative `MATURITY_LABEL_NAMES` set in the review/apply advisory-label predicate
- `src/repair/issue-source-guard.ts`: apply the same policy in trusted close, comment-router, and issue-implementation source guards
- add `maturity:stable` to both existing source-revision regression fixtures

Updating both implementations is required. A review-only change made the review digest stable but left the repair digest different for the same labeled issue.

## Validation

- `pnpm run build`
- `pnpm run build:repair`
- `node --test test/review-comment-rendering.test.ts test/repair/issue-source-guard.test.ts test/apply-label-sync.test.ts test/repair/comment-router-core.test.ts` — 170/170 passed
- cross-module digest probe — review/apply and repair/router digests both remain stable and identical after adding `maturity:stable`
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD`
- `codex review --uncommitted` — clean after the accepted repair/router alignment finding
- `codex review --base origin/main` — clean: “The maturity label is consistently excluded from both review and repair source-revision hashes, with focused coverage passing.”

`pnpm run check` on native Windows passed active-surface checks, limits, all builds, and all lint phases, then reached unrelated existing test-fixture prerequisites (`bash` via a non-Linux WSL default distro and Windows symlink permissions). No platform/test-harness files were changed. Fresh GitHub Actions CI on the exact head is the authoritative aggregate Linux gate.

## Provenance

- [PR #372](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/372), merged as `82a1bfda0da5490be8a2d90a3d26bef3f29d8509` on 2026-06-26, introduced managed `maturity:stable` synchronization
- [PR #371](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/371), merged afterward as `84796f0c9b0c04bbed1476251ff2b1465701a915`, introduced issue source-revision hashing and the parallel advisory-label predicates without maturity, creating the latent mismatch
- [PR #462](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/462), merged as `d43deab4b78d0e58ecc7525cef175106b2fc559d` on 2026-07-10, added exact issue/apply mutation enforcement and made the mismatch fail visibly
- PRs #461/#473 supplied and refined failure recovery/retry behavior
- PRs #501/#506 were investigated and were not causal

Thanks @yetval for reporting the duplicate notification and preserving the live timeline.

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/507
